diagnostic_steps.root_cause: Missing Kubernetes secrets for JWT signing key and database credentials

recommendations.command: kubectl create secret generic jwt-signing-key --from-literal=JWT_SECRET=$(openssl rand -base64 32) -n auth-service
recommendations.rationale: Create missing JWT signing key secret

recommendations.command: kubectl create secret generic db-credentials --from-literal=DB_HOST=postgres.example.com --from-literal=DB_USER=auth_user --from-literal=DB_PASSWORD=$(openssl rand -base64 24) -n auth-service
kubectl rollout restart deployment auth-service -n auth-service
recommendations.rationale: Restart pods to pick up new secrets

recommendations.command:
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: SecretStore
metadata:
  name: azure-keyvault
  namespace: auth-service
spec:
  provider:
    azurekv:
      authType: ManagedIdentity
      tenantId: <tenant-id>
      vaultUrl: https://<vault-name>.vault.azure.net/
EOF
recommendations.rationale: Configure external-secrets operator for Azure KeyVault integration
